title: Network lab 4: VLANs for staff and guests (Packet Tracer)
summary: Split one switch into a staff VLAN and a guest VLAN with real switch commands, and prove that guests can't reach staff computers.

script.intro: One switch, two kinds of people. In this lab we split a switch into a staff VLAN and a guest VLAN, and prove that a visitor can't reach staff computers even by guessing an address.
script.outro: The switch port decides the VLAN. Next we route between VLANs, on purpose and under control.
steps: One switch, two kinds of people. In this lab we split a switch into a staff VLAN and a guest VLAN, and prove that a visitor can't reach staff computers even by guessing an address.
Click the switch, open the CLI tab, and type: Type the commands on screen, then check the result with the show command.
From staff-1's Command Prompt, ping staff-2 (192.168.10.12): it answers. Ping guest-1 (192.168.20.31): it fails.
One switch, two separate networks. Guests still need the internet, and that needs a router: lab 5 joins the VLANs on purpose, with control.
